text:
Alex Su: FYI escalated — FinBridge reports that after last night's rollout their long conversations are losing the initial instructions mid-response. They say outputs stop addressing user constraints when history > ~12k tokens. They provided a failing example and request ids.
deploy-bot: rolled out hosted-api v1.12.0 -> stable (canary->100%) at 2026-02-28T21:01:12Z :rocket:
Alex Su: Customer says quality regressed immediately after that window. No auth/billing issues. They see earlier model kept following system prompt to the end. Now it drifts and sometimes truncates.
Maria Chen: Can you paste the request ids + a minimal repro? Also what model variant are they on (gpt-open, redwood-x, etc.)? We need to know if this was a model swap or runtime change.
Alex Su: They attached two request ids: req_8f3b2a and req_8f3b47. Model reported in header: redwood-llama-70b-v2-quant. They said canary->100% happened at ~21:01 UTC and customer traffic spiked around 21:05.
Priya Rao: tagging product — did we change any default context eviction or batching heuristics in v1.12.0 rollout? This reads like prefix eviction or KV-cache bug.
Devin Park: Quick notes: common causes = (1) kernel fallback (slow path) that mishandles KV pointers, (2) new batching prefix logic evicting system tokens too aggressively, (3) off-by-one in total_sequence_length check. Will try repro locally with the payload.
Alex Su: minimal repro payload from customer (redacted):
```
POST /v1/generate
{
  "model":"redwood-llama-70b-v2-quant",
  "messages":[
    {"role":"system","content":"You are an assistant that strictly follows the user constraints: ALWAYS include a 2-line summary and never reveal internal IDs."},
    {"role":"user","content":"[long 10k token conversation elided for thread] ... final question: give me the summary and follow constraints"}
  ],
  "max_new_tokens":256,
  "temperature":0.2
}
```
Alex Su: Customer's returned content (truncated): "... final answer.
Summary:" then abruptly ended with incomplete sentence. No error code returned — generation finished early.
Maria Chen: Thanks. I'm running the same payload against stable-1.11.8 and v1.12.0 images on a repro node. Early observation: v1.12.0 returns fewer tokens and sometimes drops the system instruction in the middle of the generated output when conversation length > 11k. Repro log attached to internal trace request req-int-9832.
Devin Park: Can you capture the raw logits/stop-reason? If the generator stopped because of stop tokens that'd be telling. Also need kernel selection logs: was the model executed on optimized attention or fallback path? I suspect a KV-offset bug when rolling over chunk boundaries.
Tony L.: Priority: P1 for FinBridge (enterprise, paying). Do we have a hotfix plan? If rollback is low-risk we should consider reverting to 1.11.8 for hosted-prod while we triage.
Priya Rao: Product preference: avoid full rollback unless absolutely necessary. Suggest canary a quick config change to disable the new prefix eviction heuristic (feature flag: ctx_prefix_eviction=false) and monitor for 30 min.
Maria Chen: I can push the config toggle to the fleet for FinBridge's region only and watch logs. Need confirmation of customer region and org id. Also creating INF-1423 and assigning to eng-runtime + eng-ml for follow-up.
Alex Su: Customer org id: finbridge-92. Region: us-west-2. They're happy to test the toggle; they can prod us with the failing request ids.
Devin Park: Repro steps I'm running:
- checkout runtime@v1.12.0
- load model redwood-llama-70b-v2-quant with full KV cache
- send payload with conversation length 12.1k tokens
- capture kernel selection, kv-offsets, and emitted token count
I'll post logs asap.
Maria Chen: Quick mitigation applied: ctx_prefix_eviction=false for finbridge-92 on us-west-2 at 2026-02-28T22:15Z. Monitoring now.
Alex Su: Customer retested 5 mins later: reports their summary now appears consistently. They've asked for post-mortem and timeline.
Priya Rao: Great. Once eng-runtime confirms root cause and fix timeline we'll prepare a short customer-facing summary. Assign INF-1423 to Devin + Maria, target fix branch and patch within 48h.
Devin Park: Found root cause hypothesis: an off-by-one in the eviction window for batched requests that triggered when prefix+history > threshold; led to an internal pointer shift and early termination in some quantized kernels. Reproduced locally with exact payload. Working on unit test + patch.
Tony L.: Thanks all. Keep the channel updated with status for the customer and let me know if we need to escalate to SEs for an immediate customer call.
Maria Chen: Noted. Will post final RCA and timeline in this thread when ready. :white_check_mark:
